summary: Full progress audit of Uplaud Growth Engine after fresh GitHub restore. 15/15 backend API tests pass (auth, sources CRUD, OpenAI insight extraction, public testimonial, Airtable warm-leads). All 10 dashboard pages load without console/network errors and show meaningful UI. Referral Agent (agent-run w/ OpenAI web_search + PDL research) verified working end-to-end against real Airtable base — returned research headline, summary, email + LinkedIn drafts for lead rec3O9OUfjkln38Bo. Blog backend endpoints (/api/blog, /api/admin/blog) are NOT implemented — /blog page loads with empty state.

Landing page /, business login /business, invalid share /t/xxxxx (graceful 'invalid or expired' message)
